ruleDefinitions.name: System Information Discovery Using Ioreg
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of "ioreg" which will show I/O Kit registry information.
This process is used for system information discovery.
It has been observed in-the-wild by calling this process directly or using bash and grep to look for specific strings.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/ioreg$") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ioreg.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-l.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-c.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*AppleAHCIDiskDriver.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*IOPlatformExpertDevice.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Oracle.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Parallels.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*USB\\ Vendor\\ Name.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VirtualBox.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VMware.*")))
